question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a purple ball, Bob has a black ball, Claire has a teal ball, Dave has a yellow ball, and Eve has a white ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Eve swap balls. Then, Bob and Alice swap balls. Finally, Bob and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Dave has the
Options:
(A) purple ball
(B) black ball
(C) teal ball
(D) yellow ball
(E) white ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve):
Initial: (purple, black, teal, yellow, white)
1. Dave and Eve swap: (purple, black, teal, white, yellow)
2. Eve and Alice swap: (yellow, black, teal, white, purple)
3. Dave and Eve swap: (yellow, black, teal, purple, white)
4. Bob and Alice swap: (black, yellow, teal, purple, white)
5. Bob and Claire swap: (black, teal, yellow, purple, white)
Dave has the purple ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
